simulator.name: wildshard-iphone
simulator.mode: standalone Select a shard; one cold origin/tab per variant
simulator.settling: median of three one-second native/Inspector samples after each phase
simulator.settings: devMode=true for Explorer; explicit device-scoped Debug rows; other settings default

protocol: Four variants sequential under one sim-lane; three cold Safari restarts/origin resets per variant; 30 s play then 30 s Explorer. Each cold phase median uses three one-second native and Inspector samples. Summary is the median and min/max of the THREE independent cold-run medians, not nine pooled samples. No desktop probes overlapped. Same-pin labelled GL ledger reused from the previous seven-variant wave.

investigation.finding: Desktop V8 heap retainers match and WebKit copies release on both paths; prior Simulator single-cold difference requires repeated confirmation.

interpretation: Simulator/WebKit relative evidence plus same-pin desktop labelled GL, not a physical-iPhone cap pass. Cold runs are grouped by variant, not randomized. All three runs retained; no outlier removal.

commands.sim: scripts/sim-lane.sh run --max 45 wildshard-iphone bash <four-case driver>; each: node scripts/sim-memory.mjs --url=http://127.0.0.1:4472 --shards=driftwood-isle --runs=3 --play=30 --fly=30 --out=<variant folder> --device-save=debug.plugin.driftwood-isle.driftwoodHybrid=<off|on> --device-save=debug.plugin.driftwood-isle.driftwoodGpuOnlyCopies=<off|on> --device-save=debug.plugin.driftwood-isle.driftwoodIslandInstancing=off

findings: All twelve cold runs verified build/shard/device picks; all native phase peak checks passed.
Legacy copies ON reduces play median by 82.6 MB and Explorer median by 84.3 MB, with nonoverlapping cold native ranges.

Hybrid copies ON has a 91.5 MB play cold range; its median is 9.7 MB below OFF but ranges overlap. Two ON runs stay at 615.6/624.8 MB in play then fall to 542.2/549.8 MB in Explorer. Release timing is variable; no retained-object diagnosis follows from footprint alone.
Hybrid copies ON reduces Explorer median by 86.6 MB, with nonoverlapping cold native ranges. The earlier single-cold sustained-retention inference is not confirmed.
JS geometry is about 201 MB OFF and 123 MB ON on both paths in every run. Inspector hybrid play varies by 217.0 MB OFF and 351.2 MB ON.
Same-pin labelled GL reuse gives combined play medians 888.5/805.9/907.1/897.4 MB. Every cold play/Explorer total remains below 1,000 MB; this is not a physical-iPhone pass.
Default runtimeCost refreshed to the repeat median rounded to 606.097 MB + matching 282.4 MB GL; cold range603.721–628.281MB retained as provenance. Calibration/cap/Debug defaults unchanged.
